text:
emily: Hey team, we need a quick sync on the marketplace bundle for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant. Partner wants marketplace listing, a demo env, and telemetry so SI can show performance metrics. Can we align on owners?

raj: I can own the demo infra (short-lived env for field demos). Need creds from partners and a checklist for cert items.

sarah: I'll handle the marketplace listing assets (logos, descriptions, screenshots). Legal still needs final asset tags and allowed screenshots.

mike: From runtime side, we need tracing + cost telemetry. Can we ship a light tracing shim to the connector so partner can surface per-query latency?

emily: Yes, mike please do. Requirements: minimal PII, low overhead, and an opt-out flag. Partner insists on privacy-first.

jordan: For the opt-out flag, recommend ENV var and a query param fallback. Example: `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=false` and `?redwood_telemetry=0` for demos.

mike: perfect. I'll draft a small shim. Can someone share the connector repo path and a sample config?

lucy: Partner rep sent repo: git.snowcorp.com/snowbridge/connector; they gave a dev key that expires in 72h. I'll DM it to you, mike. Also sending the legal badge requirements.

emily: Marketing wants a 3-slide demo deck and one short script for the SI to run through performance claims. Sarah, can you own the deck?

sarah: Yup. Need 2 screenshots from the demo UI and one perf chart (p95 latency). Mike can you output a simple CSV with latency samples?

mike: Yes. The shim will log to stdout and we can emit CSV like `endpoint,tokens,latency_ms`. Will also stream to our internal tracing if enabled.

raj: About the demo env: two configs — "field" (single-node, low-cost) and "soak" (3-node preprod). Which do we want for the partner demo?

emily: Start with field for the customer-facing demo. If they want higher throughput later, flip to soak.

jordan: Quick checklist item: marketplace requires a signed cert for the connector binary, SHA256 checksum, and a compatibility matrix (OS, hw). Can eng-runtime provide the checksum generation?

mike: yes, build pipeline can publish signed artifact and checksum to the release bucket. I'll add a step.

lucy: Partner legal asked about data residency for EU demos. We should confirm the demo cluster region and that telemetry is stored only in EU if requested.

emily: Noted. Raj, can you spin EU demo region for them?

raj: I can. ETA 24h after I get confirmation on exact region (e.g., eu-west-1) and the partner account number.

sarah: Marketing note: need partner-approved quote for the announcement. Lucy, can you coordinate legal sign-off so we don't miss embargo?

lucy: On it. I'll ping partner legal and loop in our legal. Goal: sign-off within 48h.

mike: Drafting shim now. Pushing a branch `feature/marketplace-telemetry` by EOD. Will include README with how to enable/disable and sample CSV output.

emily: Awesome. Next sync after artifacts landed: tomorrow 10am PT. If anyone can't make it, drop updates here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: build started for mike/feature/marketplace-telemetry commit 7d9a2c — CI: running unit tests and signing step.

mike: CI green so far. Signing step queued. Will post artifacts link once done.

emily: Thanks everyone — big focus is make the demo frictionless for SI and keep telemetry privacy-first.
